Wallet upgrade failed
Do not uninstall ZCHAT or clear its data.

ZCHAT could not open your wallet after this update. Your funds are still on the Zcash blockchain, but unless you saved your recovery phrase, this phone is the only place it is stored. Back up your recovery phrase now: with it you can restore your wallet on any device. Then get help at zsend.xyz/update. Try again restarts ZCHAT and makes it open your wallet once more.
Error: %1$s
Back up recovery phrase
Try again
Wallet data from a different recovery phrase

The wallet data on this phone was made with a different recovery phrase than the one ZCHAT has saved, so ZCHAT cannot open it. Funds of that other wallet can only be reached with its own recovery phrase. ZCHAT can set the old data aside and scan the blockchain again for your saved recovery phrase. The old data stays on this phone; nothing is deleted. The scan can take a while.
Set old data aside and rescan
ZCHAT could not set the old data aside. Nothing was changed.
ZCHAT can\'t read your recovery phrase

ZCHAT cannot unlock the place where your recovery phrase is stored. If your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) only failed to answer, tap Try again; if it keeps happening, restart your phone and open ZCHAT again. If the phone has lost the key for that place, ZCHAT cannot read the phrase on this phone any more, and the wallet\'s funds are reached with your written recovery phrase. Nothing was changed or deleted.
ZCHAT can\'t set up its storage right now

Your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) did not work when ZCHAT set up its protected storage, so there is no protected place for a wallet on this phone yet. No wallet was saved, and nothing of yours was deleted. Tap Try again. If it keeps happening, restart your phone and open ZCHAT again.
ZCHAT can\'t open your chats right now

Your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) did not answer, so ZCHAT cannot open the encrypted storage of your chats and chat keys. Nothing was deleted: your chats and your wallet are still on this phone. Tap Try again. If it keeps happening, restart your phone and open ZCHAT again.
Part of your chat data was set aside

Your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) could not open part of ZCHAT\'s encrypted storage, so ZCHAT started that part empty. Chats, chat keys, contact names, pictures or AI chats can be missing. ZCHAT kept an exact copy first, and nothing was deleted. Tap Restore my chats to put the copy back. That works once your phone\'s security system can read it again; if it still can\'t, ZCHAT keeps the copy and asks again later. If it keeps failing, ZCHAT stops asking by itself, and you can try again from More → Advanced Settings → Restore old chats. You can also continue without the copy: it stays on this phone, and while this wallet is the one in ZCHAT you can ask for it again from More → Advanced Settings → Restore old chats.
Restore my chats
Continue without them
This did not work. Nothing was changed. Try again.
The kept copy can\'t be unlocked

ZCHAT put the kept copy of your chat data back, and your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) still cannot unlock it. The key it was locked with is gone for good, so what the copy holds cannot be read on this phone. ZCHAT will not ask about it again. Nothing was deleted: the copy stays on this phone. Your wallet and your funds are untouched, and your new chats are kept on this phone. Tap Continue to open ZCHAT.
Continue
The kept copy waits for later

ZCHAT put the kept copy of your chat data back, but your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) did not answer, so the copy could not be unlocked right now. This does not mean the key is lost. The copy is kept on this phone, and ZCHAT will offer it again later, once your phone\'s security system answers. Nothing was deleted. Your wallet and your funds are untouched, and your new chats are kept on this phone. Tap Continue to open ZCHAT. If this keeps happening, restart your phone.
Continue

Your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) answers again, so ZCHAT offers the kept copy again. You have used ZCHAT since that part of your chat data was set aside. Tap Restore my chats to put the kept copy back in place of what ZCHAT holds there now: what it holds now is then kept as a copy on this phone and offered to you again. Nothing is deleted. If your phone\'s security system still can\'t read the kept copy, ZCHAT keeps it and asks again later. If it keeps failing, ZCHAT stops asking by itself, and you can try again from More → Advanced Settings → Restore old chats. If you continue without the copy, it stays on this phone; ZCHAT stops offering it by itself, and while this wallet is the one in ZCHAT you can ask for it again from More → Advanced Settings → Restore old chats.
The kept copy stays on this phone

ZCHAT put the kept copy of your chat data back several times, and each time your phone\'s security system (Android Keystore) could not unlock it. Nothing shows that the key is lost. So that you are not asked again and again, ZCHAT stops offering the copy by itself. The copy stays on this phone, and nothing was deleted. To try again, for example after you restart your phone, open More → Advanced Settings → Restore old chats. Your wallet and your funds are untouched, and your new chats are kept on this phone. Tap Continue to open ZCHAT.
Continue
